ينتظرون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَظِرُونَ (yantaẓirūna) /jan.ta.ðˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# يُنْتَظَرُونَ (yuntaẓarūna) /jun.ta.ðˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
